answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and keeps one public trellis row. Each epoch a beacon whisper summons 5% of identities, who must echo their trellis checksum in an hour or lose the bond. A fake needs its own row and a machine answering each whisper: first 32, k-th 32+4(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 2,030,000, rewards at most 40,000. A rented echo fails: identical timing flags the cluster and burns every bond. An honest agent pays 32 when summoned.
